edbDesc: A current passing through two wires connected by a loose wire in a magnetic field causes the loose wire to be catapulted horizontally away from the magnetic field due to the magnetic forces acting in the wires and in the magnetic field itself.
title: Catapult Effect
pickWhy: A current-carrying wire being shoved by a magnet is Faraday's Electrical motion card (the database guess 'catapult' is the siege weapon, not this).
